The remaining passages concern a film listing, a hotel-booking company's revenue, a music performance, and a global count of tattoo studios, none of which say what UK tattooists earn or spend.

entries.title: The Planning Objection API
entries.oneLiner: An API that ingests a UK planning application's PDF (location, drawings, covering letter) and auto-generates a legally-formatted, hyper-local objection letter that cites specific policies from the Local Plan, ready for the objector to submit.
entries.reason: One passage advertises an existing UK service that already does this exact job, a free planning objection scan that tells you which concerns carry planning weight and produces a downloadable editable draft objection letter for any UK council, and another offers free sample objection wording and a table of valid grounds. A free product already delivering the paid output leaves no evidence the space is open, though the passages do not say how large or well-funded that provider is.

entries.title: The Solo Scaffolder's Safety Certifier

entries.reason: The passages describe an existing TG20 eGuide with a built-in compliance sheet generator, and state that most scaffolding contractors already subscribe to it as a normal cost of doing business, that is the same job the candidate proposes to do, already bought by nearly everyone in the trade. Separately, commercial scaffold design software with paid monthly plans is also on sale, so the compliance-document need is already served rather than open.

entries.title: AsbestosStop Pay, daily income when plumbers, electricians and fitters legally have to stop work after finding asbestos
entries.oneLiner: Pays plumbers, electricians, kitchen fitters and heating engineers a fixed amount for every working day they lose when an asbestos find forces a legal work stoppage.

entries.title: QuoteLock, The 90-day materials price lock that keeps UK builders' quotes profitable
entries.oneLiner: A sole-trader builder's price guarantee: lock your materials cost for up to 90 days, and we pay the difference if suppliers move the price before you order.
entries.reason: The candidate claims UK materials price volatility is currently acute enough that trades cannot absorb swings, but the passages show the opposite trend: 'volatility of materials costs dominated 2022, [with] much cooler prices...the norm in 2023' and the material price index 'decreased by 2.0% in May 2024 compared to May 2023'. The acute volatility window that the candidate's hypothesis and 'why now' depend on has demonstrably cooled, undermining the claim that this is a live, acute problem people will pay to solve right now.

entries.title: ScaffoldPreFlight, the scaffolder's photo-evidenced weekly inspection register
entries.oneLiner: The tool that turns every scaffolder's weekly inspection into a photo-evidenced, signed compliance record, with automatic next-inspection reminders and 7-year retention.
entries.reason: SMART Scaffolder already provides scaffold-specific digital inspections, handovers, and compliance paperwork, with substantial traction (85,000 paperless reports per month), and a 2019-dated mobile app already targets weekly scaffold inspections specifically. The space is not underserved, a scaffold-focused rival has captured this segment. SafetyCulture/IAuditor also operates as a broader incumbent, though passage notes adoption barriers for UK SMEs.

entries.title: DeputyDesk, the fixed-fee service that files your deputyship application when there's no Power of Attorney
entries.oneLiner: A fixed-fee broker that files a deputyship application to get you legally appointed to manage a parent's money and welfare when they lose capacity without a Power of Attorney.
entries.reason: Passages show non-means tested legal aid is available for Court of Protection cases (sources 369fb473e07b8279, 464e0ae5c9d44c4d, 191183ca4b2fe12c), meaning families can obtain solicitor representation for deputyship applications without paying out of pocket. Combined with evidence that family caregivers face significant financial burden (source 3b2b01e44512b664), this structurally undermines payer_solvency, the family has neither the need nor likely the willingness to pay £1,995 when a free legal-aid-funded route exists for the same Court of Protection process.

entries.title: FootCare Walk-In, the high-street foot care clinic for elderly and disabled people, booked by their primary carers
entries.oneLiner: A chain of high-street foot care clinics where primary carers book same-week 30-minute toenail and foot care appointments for the relative they look after.
entries.reason: Multiple passages describe UK unpaid carers as being in 'acute financial hardship', 'financially precarious situations' and 'less able to cope with additional costs', and falling into 'financial misery' from the cost-of-living crisis, with even Carer's Allowance at £67.60/week seen as inadequate. For a discretionary non-clinical service at £45 per visit or £20/month, this paints a target segment under severe financial strain, weighing against the ability and willingness to pay.

entries.title: CarerCredit Catch, the carer's tool that finds the State Pension years you should have claimed for caring, and tells you which to top up for the biggest boost
entries.oneLiner: Pull your National Insurance record, find every year you should have claimed Carer's Credit for caring, and top up only the years that give the biggest pension boost.
entries.reason: The passages show the target population is overwhelmingly financially strained: 1.2 million unpaid carers live in poverty and 400,000 in deep poverty, with a 43% poverty rate for those providing 35+ hours of care, forced reductions in working hours from April 2024, and detrimental effects on employment and earnings. This evidence indicates the typical primary carer aged 50-67 who gave up paid work lacks the discretionary budget for a £79-149 tool, even if the potential pension upside creates motive.

entries.title: WattRefund, the Texas small business tool that finds overcharges on your electricity bill and gets your money back

entries.reason: The passages show multiple established firms already perform commercial electricity bill audits to identify overcharges and billing errors in Texas, including on a contingency-fee basis identical to the candidate's model (e.g., Applied Utility Auditors, Texas Engineering Services, and a Dallas-based automated utility invoice auditing company). The exact same value proposition, finding billing errors and recovering money, already has multiple incumbents, so the space is not underserved.

entries.title: WEP Watch, your Texas-sized forecast of the Windfall Elimination bite before you claim
entries.oneLiner: A personalized data brief that shows how much the SSA will cut your Social Security under the Windfall Elimination Provision and the real odds of overturning it.
entries.reason: Passages state WEP was repealed on January 5, 2025 under the Social Security Fairness Act, with SSA recalculating benefits afterward. The product’s core value, forecasting ongoing WEP cuts and appeal paths, therefore no longer rests on a live reduction rule.

entries.title: PropTax Appeal Kit, your DIY property tax appeal report for California homeowners
entries.oneLiner: A step-by-step tool that pulls recent home sales to build an evidence-backed case for a lower property tax assessment, saving thousands without a lawyer.
entries.reason: Passages already offer free California appeal templates and comparable-property worksheets, free DIY guides that teach pulling comps and building an appeal-ready analysis, and a free AI appraisal plus a complete DIY appeal kit with letter, comps, and filing guide. That means the paid one-off report package is already available at no cost, so there is no lasting paid margin left for this offering.

entries.title: BackMile, The gig worker's missed-deduction reclaim service. For a fixed fee, we dig through your last 3 years of platform earnings, file amended returns, and get you back what the IRS owes.
entries.oneLiner: We find every missed business deduction in your past 3 years of Uber, DoorDash, or Instacart work and file amended returns to get your money back.
entries.reason: TurboTax is repeatedly cited as a dominant incumbent that already offers exactly the overlapping capability: free support for independent contractors with hundreds of built-in deductions, tutorials for amending returns on Form 1040-X, and TurboTax Experts available 24/7 to identify missed deductions and file amended returns. That footprint, a market-leading tax-prep brand with dedicated contractor tooling and expert-assisted amendment services, is a clear market leader with dominant share in the space BackMile targets, satisfying the incumbency refutation threshold.

entries.title: BandShift, the primary carer's fixed-fee council tax band appeal broker

entries.reason: Passages on unpaid carers, the named payer, show sharply elevated poverty and financial hardship, including deep poverty for about one in ten carers and poverty rates far above non-carers. That portrays this payer group as often unable to fund discretionary spend, so the claim that they can and will pay does not hold on this evidence.

entries.title: IHSS HourClaim, the primary carer's tool that builds your In-Home Supportive Services appeal packet, using the state's own rules to get the hours you're owed
entries.oneLiner: A web app that steps a California primary carer through a functional assessment of their loved one, then generates a ready‑to‑file IHSS fair hearing appeal packed with data‑backed arguments.
entries.reason: The passages state that in California only licensed attorneys may practice law or give legal advice, and that doing so without a license is a crime; the tool's core offering, individually tailored legal arguments and a ready-to-file appeal packet for a specific person's hearing, is legal advice delivered by a non-attorney business, which these passages say is prohibited. entries.title: CareFee Lens, the self-funder’s window into what your council really pays for care

entries.reason: Free league tables already publish local-authority care rates gathered by FOI across all 173 English and Welsh councils, including residential homes, and current fee-rate maps continue that coverage. That free public dataset removes the paid tool’s claimed durable edge in aggregating and selling council rates obtained the same way.

entries.title: AssessAid, the carer's statutory assessment evidence dossier builder

That closes the beginner-accessible community channels the passages describe, so they show no open, freely executable route to paying carers.

entries.title: TrendStitch, The freelance designer's monthly data brief forecasting which tools and specialties will pay in three months

Because the forecast model cannot operate without scraping LinkedIn job listings at scale, the service is contractually blocked from existing as described.

entries.title: DecibelKit, the home noise evidence pack that makes the council act

Separately, most noise is not judged by a fixed decibel maximum, which undercuts the lasting value of selling a calibrated meter as decisive proof.

This evidence directly undermines the viability of a self-serve web route to reach over-80s and digitally excluded retirees who form the core audience.

Without that purchase, the claimed acute problem of carers needing paid help to resell a bought Motability car does not exist now.

entries.title: MouldBreak, the home mould survey that makes your landlord or council fix the damp
entries.oneLiner: A trained surveyor visits your home, takes air samples and thermal images, and gives you a report that quotes the exact legal duties your landlord or council is breaking, so they cannot ignore you.
entries.reason: Passage describes an existing service already producing Awaab's Law-compliant survey reports that are 'trusted by councils' and priced from £250+VAT, the same price band as the candidate's £199, £299 offering. Passage shows professional damp/mould survey reporting software for UK surveyors is an established category. Additionally, passages,, and show well-funded, established law firms (e.g. NJS Law with 4.8 Trustpilot) already offering tenants a no-win-no-fee route to enforce the same Awaab's Law deadl

entries.title: RentRewind, get back rent from unlicensed HMO landlords, fixed fee
entries.oneLiner: A fixed-fee service that checks if your shared house needs a licence and builds your rent repayment application.
entries.reason: The core value RentRewind offers, a licensing-status check plus a ready-to-file Rent Repayment Order pack, is already covered by free alternatives. A free licence checker covering 350+ schemes and additional free checkers commoditise the licensing verification step, while the government RRO1 form itself is freely downloadable from the First-tier Tribunal. With both the data lookup and the application template available at no cost, the remaining margin for a £99 productised dossier is substantially eroded.

entries.title: PotholePay Kit, the car owner's instant pothole damage claim pack
entries.oneLiner: A smartphone‑based toolkit that captures impact evidence and compiles a compensation claim for your local council, backed by a proprietary payout database.
entries.reason: Free UK guides already teach rights, evidence gathering, and claim wording, including MoneySavingExpert tips and template letters, and an official checklist of what to tell the highway body. A further passage states pothole damage claims are meant to be straightforward and cost-free and that claimants do not need a claims management company, so a paid claim-pack’s edge is already given away for free.

entries.title: HeatLeak Ledger, a thermal camera home survey that gives you a report of heat leaks and the paperwork to claim government insulation grants
entries.oneLiner: A portable thermal imaging service for NHS and council staff who want independent proof of their home’s heat loss before applying for the ECO4 or Great British Insulation Scheme.
entries.reason: One passage states that most ECO4 funding has ended, so the grant-claim paperwork this paid survey sells against is largely gone. Another describes ECO4 home surveys already done by qualified professionals to decide free efficiency upgrades, so a free in-scheme assessment already covers that need.

entries.title: SaltCourt Rounds, The Council Leisure Manager's Portable Pool-Hall & Sports-Floor Slip-Coefficient Reinstatement Round
entries.oneLiner: A one-person mobile bench that turns up out-of-hours at school and council-run sports halls, wet-changing rooms and poolside walkways, mechanically re-tests the floor's slip resistance to the BS 7976 pendulum method, and, in the same visit, performs a measured abrasive/chemical reinstatement pass that lifts the reading back above the wet-barefoot threshold, leaving a signed before/after pendulum ledger the duty-holder can put in front of an insurer or a claimant's solicitor.
entries.reason: The passages show the UK leisure-centre slip-testing space is already served by multiple established nationwide providers, National Testing, UKAS ISO 17025 accredited pendulum testers, and Slip Safety marketing HSE-endorsed pendulum testing directly at leisure centres, alongside nationwide anti-slip treatment contractors. Critically, describes a provider already bundling anti-slip treatment AND pendulum slip testing in one offering, which is the candidate's supposed structural gap

entries.title: SplitCare Rebate, The Primary Carer's Council-Tax Second-Adult & Care-Occupancy Reclassification Broker
entries.oneLiner: A fixed-fee transaction broker that reconstructs a caring household's occupancy history and executes the specific council-tax reclassification claims (second-adult rebate, carer disregard, annexe/dependent-relative exemption, banding-effect adaptations) with the billing authority, charging per successful reclassification plus a slice of the backdated refund.
entries.reason: The named payer segment, unpaid carers in caring households, is described as frequently in poverty or financial hardship, facing extra care costs and higher household bills, and increasingly unable to afford day-to-day living costs to the point of skipping meals, which contradicts the ability to pay a £145 upfront per-claim fee. Related passages frame this cohort as one needing help because it cannot afford bills including council tax, reinforcing constrained cash rather than available budget.

entries.title: ReferencePass, The Multi-App Gig Worker's Tenancy Referencing Pass-Dossier Desk
entries.oneLiner: A fixed-fee productized service that reconstructs a gig worker's fragmented multi-platform income into the exact evidence format each automated tenancy-referencing agency's underwriting rules will accept, before the application is submitted, so the reference passes first time.
entries.reason: Housing Hand is described as 'the UK's largest and most trusted professional rent guarantor service', having supported over 100,000 students and young working professionals and standing as guarantor for those unable to provide one, a dominant incumbent that directly resolves the exact failure the candidate monetises (applicant fails referencing and lacks a guarantor). Tenant-side help also already exists (Fraser Bond's expert guidance for those who failed referencing), so the space is not shown to be open.

entries.title: S117Broker, The Primary Carer's Mental Health Act s.117 Aftercare Activation & Means-Test-Defence Desk
entries.oneLiner: A fixed-fee, per-case transaction broker for primary carers of adults detained (or previously detained) under the Mental Health Act 1983 who reactivates a free, non-means-tested Section 117 aftercare package from the local authority and Integrated Care Board, and recovers three years of illegally means-tested charges when the LA cites Care Act assessments, at £795 per case activated or 20% of charges reversed, whichever is greater.
entries.reason: Passages directly indicate primary carers are disproportionately from low-income households, receive only £81.90/week carer's allowance, and qualify for free legal aid specifically targeting low-income and disabled individuals, structurally undermining ability to pay £795+ upfront.

entries.title: AllotmentClock, The Independent Tree Surgeon & Arborist's Per-Tree Preservation Order & Conservation-Area Notice Clock
entries.oneLiner: A vertical tool that tells a sole-trader arborist, before quoting, exactly which of the trees at a given address are legally gated (TPO / conservation-area / felling-licence) and prints the correct notice with the correct clock, so the quote is priced with the 6-week statutory wait, not blown up by it.
entries.reason: A UK-wide interactive TPO map already lets anyone check by postcode whether trees are protected before starting work, and Arb Quotes already occupies the tree-work quoting workflow this tool would sit inside, so both halves of the wedge are served by existing national-scale products rather than an open space.

entries.title: KerbRound, The Primary Carer's Multi-Borough PCN Cancellation & Carer-Permit Stack Broker
entries.oneLiner: A no-cancel-no-fee transaction broker that kills the parking, bus-lane and moving-traffic penalties a family carer racks up on their daily care round, then re-plans the round onto a stack of discretionary carer/health-worker permits and low-enforcement kerb space, priced per PCN cancelled and per permit granted.
entries.reason: The passages show the PCN-appeal transaction is already occupied at scale by a free incumbent, DoNotPay, which has successfully challenged 160,000 parking tickets (~$4m) in London and New York and is marketed as making appeals effortless, and by an existing no-win-no-fee parking-ticket appeal operator using the identical pricing model KerbRound proposes. That is a free dominant-volume service plus a direct commercial rival on the same segment, not an open space.

entries.title: BedFall Bench, The Independent Care-Home Owner's Per-Bedroom Furniture Entrapment & Gap-Measurement Bench
entries.oneLiner: A camera-and-caliper vertical tool that lets a single-site care-home owner measure, log and re-prove every bed rail, hoist and window-restrictor dimensional gap in their building against the MHRA/CQC entrapment zones, producing a per-bedroom dimensional ledger that becomes the home's own defence asset when an incident or inspection lands.
entries.reason: Passage describes an existing service offering exactly the candidate's core function, helping care homes check bed rail measurements, equipment compatibility and inspection records for compliance, and shows a monthly bed-rail audit template already referenced to CQC Regulation 12, so the dimensional-check need is already being served rather than open. The passages do not establish dominant market share, so this is a competitor-occupied space rather than a proven monopoly.

entries.title: MeterSplit Rounds, The Under-27 HMO Renter's Sub-Metered Utility Overcharge Reconstruction & Refund Round
entries.oneLiner: A fixed-fee productized service that reconstructs, from a landlord's own resale-of-energy billing records, how much a shared-house tenant was overcharged above the Maximum Resale Price, and runs the recovery to conclusion.
entries.gateLabel: There is no route to reach buyers
entries.reason: Two of the three named routes are contradicted by the passages: the renter-forum rules explicitly prohibit linking to, advertising, soliciting business for, or recommending any paid service, and the student-housing bodies described are landlord-facing, Unipol runs Landlord Clinics in Leeds, Bradford and Nottingham to support landlords, and the university-union event celebrates landlords alongside union representatives, an implausible host for a service that pursues those same landlords for refunds. entries.title: CustodyClock, The Primary Carer's Court-Ordered Contact Breach Reconstruction & Enforcement Filing Broker
entries.oneLiner: A fixed-fee transaction broker that reconstructs a year of missed, curtailed or sabotaged child-contact handovers into a court-ready C79 enforcement application for separated primary carers, charging £220 per filed application plus £90 per subsequent breach schedule update.
entries.reason: The passages describing this payer segment state single-parent families are nearly twice as likely to be in poverty (67%), and that single parents on low income are directed to charity grants and free one-to-one legal support, evidence of a structurally cash-constrained payer, not one with budget. entries.title: SharpsCount Rounds, The NHS Ward Sister's Overnight Instrument-Tray Photo-Census & Loan-Kit Shortfall Round
entries.oneLiner: A physical night-round service that photo-censuses reusable surgical/procedure trays and loan kits across a hospital's wards and theatres before the 07:00 list, producing a signed shortfall sheet that ward sisters use to stop a cancelled list being blamed on their department.
entries.reason: The passages show funded incumbents already selling exactly this capability: Censis offers AI-driven surgical instrument management for sterile processing departments, enterprise deployments of such tracking systems are widespread enough to have documented 18-36 month ROI benchmarks and an established global market with active competition, and one system explicitly tracks dispatch and receipt of orthopaedic implant loan kits, the candidate's core chain-of-custody need.
